C1354.title: BEC Token Integer Overflow Attack Incident
C1354.summary: On April 22, 2018, an attacker exploited an integer overflow vulnerability in the batchTransfer function of the BEC smart contract. By passing extremely large values, a multiplication operation overflowed, causing the amount variable to become zero and bypassing balance checks.
